_fixture_note.purpose: Real recording for issue #468 (10bis retired api/v1.0/Restaurants/{id}/Menu, which answers 404 for every id) and #44 (record a real 10bis fixture). TenBisMenuMapper is tested against it and the golden corpus maps it (tenbis_menu, D25).
_fixture_note.redactions: ShoppingCartGuid, a fresh random id 10bis issues per request, is replaced by zeros. Nothing else in the response identifies a caller; it carries only public menu data.
_fixture_note.trimmed: Each of the 19 categories keeps 2 of its dishes (one with an empty dishImageUrl where the category has one), 38 of 247, so the goldens built from this menu stay small. Every kept dish, choice and sub is byte-for-byte what 10bis sent.

raw._synthetic: SYNTHETIC. A 2xx body 10bis has never been observed to send, used to exercise the platformChanged path when the response is valid JSON but not the GetRestaurantMenu envelope this mapper knows (no Success, no Data) (architecture.md §8).
